what: Canvas reference for the software canvas (Ctx, page 12 section 4): 40 numbered cases drawn with the browser 2D canvas into 64 x 64 tiles.
browser: Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) HeadlessChrome/157.0.8103.78 Safari/537.36
tileFormat: tiles/NN.bin: 64 * 64 * 4 bytes, RGBA, straight (not premultiplied) alpha as getImageData returns it, row-major, NN = the case number with two digits
sheet: sheet.png: the 40 tiles, 8 across and 5 down, case numbers above each tile, over a grey checkerboard where transparent, enlarged 3 times. For looking only.

replay.about: Replay a case on a new Ctx of 64 x 64: run its ops in order. Each op is an array: the name, then the arguments.
replay.setters: fillStyle and strokeStyle: [name, css, [r, g, b, a8]]: use the resolved bytes (a8 = round(alpha * 255)). globalAlpha, lineWidth: [name, number]. imageSmoothingEnabled: [name, bool] is Ctx.smoothing. Every case begins with imageSmoothingEnabled.
replay.calls: save, restore, translate(x, y), scale(x, y), rotate(a), fillRect(x, y, w, h), clearRect(x, y, w, h), beginPath, rect(x, y, w, h), arc(x, y, r, a0, a1), ellipse(x, y, rx, ry, rot, a0, a1), moveTo(x, y), lineTo(x, y), fill, stroke, clip.
replay.drawImage: ["drawImage", source, dx, dy] and ["drawImage", source, dx, dy, dw, dh] are Ctx.drawImage; ["drawImageRect", source, sx, sy, sw, sh, dx, dy, dw, dh] is Ctx.drawImageRect (the browser's nine-argument drawImage). `source` is a key of "sources": a Sprite of that width and height from the RGBA bytes in its file.
replay.angles: arc and ellipse go clockwise from a0 to a1 in canvas coordinates (y down). A sweep of 2 pi or more (the old code writes 7) is a full circle. arc(x, y, r, Math.PI, 0) is the upper half. There is no anticlockwise argument.
replay.clip: clip() intersects the clip with the current path under the current transform; save and restore bring the earlier clip back.
